notes: S3.4 incorrectly states that ignored inputs leave busy, work_parity, parity, and done unchanged. Ignoring an input means that the input itself does not alter the active frame or published result; it does not freeze all state evolution. In particular, done must clear after its one-cycle pulse even on an idle edge containing an ignored finish or bit, and a start asserted while busy does not block an independently valid frame bit from updating work_parity. The final RTL correctly implements the trusted semantics and passes trusted simulation and bounded formal verification.
